description.value: A family-owned winery on Westminster Highway in Richmond with a retail shop and tasting room. They produce award-winning wines using grapes grown on their own farmland on Lulu Island. A welcoming stop along the flat Richmond cycling corridors, with events like paint nights and bingo alongside regular tastings.

address.value: 16880 Westminster Hwy, Richmond BC Canada V6V 1A8
